cases.expect: Neutral input/manual controls yields unchanged correction, no render/history/redo loss/autosave revision.
Known synthetic casts produce bounded correction, compensate both existing manual algorithms and preserve reference/EV/tone/shadows.
Second distinct auto request on same pre-WB input/manual settings is no-op; prior picked correction is replaced, never multiplied twice.
Dark, saturated, risk-interpolated, missing-quadrant, unstable/mixed-light and insufficient samples reject prewrite; dominant-colour limitation remains explicit.
4096px proxy cropped to 1×1 or either axis <32 cannot pass by fixed-proxy resizing; no independent samples manufactured.
CPU/GPU unknown or insufficient available memory, cold prefix, excessive rotated raster and worker/inspection ownership refuse before expensive new work.
Non-neutral final canvas flip remains an unavailable capture condition, without discarding or relabelling the flip.
Stale load/document/revision/source instance/crop/token, changed request reused ID, UI-supplied gains and fake picker proof cannot commit.
Pending/unknown only queries original native ID. Wrong document/input/event, duplicate JSON keys, restart and oversized receipt never prove success.
Native no-write auto rejection cannot clear an exposure/manual-WB pending fence with the same ID or suppress that owner's actual terminal.
Malformed auto failure can affect only the exact retained original auto owner and RX epoch, not manual WB or a replacement process sharing an ID.

Unknown auto WB and final-canvas flip cannot be laundered through project create, which retains live documents; project_created cannot clear either native fence or advance flip recovery generation. Clean create remains allowed.
Fault before set, failed render with successful exact rollback, failed rollback and history-finalization failure produce distinct rejection/rollback/unknown; no taint for proved no-write or rollback.
Effective auto is one ordinary non-coalesced Undo step including at the 64-step cap; Undo/Redo restores identical canonical options/manual/reference and non-WB layers.
Project save/reopen preserves exact fixed canonical correction; absent legacy options and malformed explicit recipe rejection retain existing behaviour.
Both WB algorithms with auto/picker gains retain canonical null reference through Undo/Redo/save/reopen; only renderer math resolves 6500. Explicit 7000 K stays 7000.
RGB8/RGB16 and full-resolution export use the same saved canonical WB values through existing output paths, not sampling proxy enlargement or re-estimation.
Ordinary preset/transfer copies fixed results only, not an auto mode or per-photo batch re-estimate; AI WB/exposure controls remain open.

Exact ordinary-auto leaf enabled only with matching helper/input and compatible single view; repeated clicks, folding, unmount, navigation, timeout and failed refresh do not resend or optimistically change controls.
Staged helper protocol and 41,000-byte ABI match; absent/wrong helper rejects without Python/manual/picker fallback; core/curves retains 16 KiB limit.
